newsitem.title: CHINA: Singapore PM Goh to make working visit to China.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM Goh to make working visit to China.

text.p: Singaporean Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will make a working visit to China from April 27 to May 3, a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.
Goh would come at the invitation of Chinese Premier Li Peng and would meet with a number of leaders in Beijing, spokesman Cui Tiankai told a news briefing in Beijing.
The Singaporean prime minister would also visit other Chinese cities, Cui said but gave no details.
The visit would further deepen Sino-Singaporean relations, which were already very friendly, he said.
"We believe the working visit by Prime Minister Goh will have a positive effect in this area," he said.
